title: The Dinosaur Museum
subject: listening

paragraphs.text: Section 2
Hello, and thank you for asking me to your teachers' meeting to talk about the Dinosaur Museum and to tell you a bit about what you can do with your students there.

Well, let me give you some of the basic information first. In regard to opening hours, we're open every day of the week from 9: 00 am to 8:00 pm except on Mondays when we close at 1:30 pm. And, in fact the only day in the year when we’re closed is on the 25th of December.
You can book a guided tour for your school group any time that we're open.

If you bring a school group to the museum, when you arrive we ask you to remain with your group in the car park. One or more of the tour guides will welcome you there and brief you about what the tour will be about. We do this there because our entrance is quite small and we really haven't got much room for briefing groups in the exhibition area.

As far as the amount of time you'll need goes, if you bring a school group you should plan on allowing a minimum of 90 minutes for the visit. This allows 15 minutes to get on and off the coach, 45 minutes for the guided tour and 30 minutes for after-tour activities.

If you're going to have lunch at the museum you will, of course, have to allow more time. There are two cafes in the museum, with seating for 80 people. If you want to eat there you'll need to reserve some seating, as they can get quite crowded at lunch time.Then outside the museum at the back there are tables, and students can bring their own lunch and eat it there in the open air.

When the students come into the museum foyer we ask them to check in their backpacks with their books, lunch boxes, etc, at the cloakroom before they enter the museum proper. I'm afraid in the past we have had a few things gone missing after school visits so this is a strict rule.

Also, some of the exhibits are fragile and we don't want them to be accidentally knocked. But we do provide school students with handouts with questions and quizzes on them. There's so much that students can learn in the museum and it's fun for them to have something to do.

Of course they'll need to bring something to write with for these. We do allow students to take photographs. For students who are doing projects it’s useful to make some kind of visual record of what they see that they can add to their reports. And finally, they should not bring anything to eat into the museum, or drinks of any kind.

There are also a few things the students can do after the tour. In the theatrette on the ground floor there are continuous screenings of short documentaries about dinosaurs which they can see at any time. We used to have an activity room with more interactive things like making models of dinosaurs and drawing and painting pictures, even hunting for dinosaur eggs, but unfortunately the room was damaged in a bad storm recently when water came in the roof, so that's closed at the moment. But we do have an IT centre where students have access to CD ROMs with a range of dinosaur games. These games are a lot of fun, but they also teach the students about the lives of dinosaurs, how they found food, protected their habitat, survived threats, that kind of thing.
And ... I think that's all I have to tell you. Please feel free to ask any questions if you would like to know anything else...
大家好，非常感谢你们邀请我来到教师会议来说一下恐龙博物馆，以及你们和学生可以在这里做什么。
好的，那么首先让我介绍一点基本信息。关于开放时间，除了周一是下午1：30关闭，其他时间都是早上9：00到晚上8：00。事实上一年到头我们只有十二月25号是闭馆的。你可以在开放时间里为你们学校组团游预定票子。
如果你带学生组团来我们博物馆，我们的要求是你们到的时候现在停车场停留。一个或者更多导游会来迎接你们，然后简短地告知你们接下来的形成大致是什么。我们在停车场做这些安排是因为我们进口比较小，而且我们的展示区域也没有足够空间。
考虑到你们需要时间走路，如果你们要带团游你们应该做好计划至少留出90分钟来参观博物馆。这样就有15分钟上下汽车，45分钟跟着导游参观以及30分钟做游玩后活动。如果你们准备在博物馆吃午餐，你们当然就需要更多时间啦。博物馆里有两个小餐馆，可以容纳80人。如果你想在那吃饭，你们想要在那里吃，你们需要提前预定，因为那里午餐时间比较拥挤。然后出了博物馆往后面走有露天桌子，学生也可以自己带午饭在那里吃。
在学生进入博物馆之前，我们会在博物馆大厅检查他们的书包看看他们的书本以及午餐盒等等。我很抱歉，我们以前在学生游玩过之后又一些东西不见了，所以这是一个严格的规则。而且一些展览品也很易碎，我们不希望它们不下心被打碎。但是我们提供学校学生讲义，讲义上面有各种问题和小测验。
博物馆里学生可以学的东西有很多，而且对于他们来说有事可做是有趣的。当然他们也需要带一些笔做讲义。我们确实允许学生拍照。对于那些正在研究项目的学生来说，可以记录看见的东西然后加到自己报告里是非常有用的。最后，他们不可以带任何食物和饮料到博物馆。

参观完成之后他们还可以做一些活动。在一楼剧场一直播放着恐龙短的纪录片，他们可以在任何时间去看一下。我们以前有活动房间，里面有许多互动活动，比如做恐龙模型画画甚至是搜寻恐龙蛋，但不幸的是因为暴风雨的雨水从屋顶进入，房屋受损了，所以只能暂时关闭。但是我们还有IT中心，在那里学生可以碰到许多光盘，上面有许多恐龙游戏。这些游戏很有意思，但是他们也会教会学生恐龙的一声，恐龙如何觅食，保护领地，在危机下生存，等等。
我想说的就这么多。如果你想了解其他事情，可以向我提问。
